Subject: Request: availability support for Sep pilot

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — we’re excited to move into a September pilot for Solace Health's document ingestion assistant. Our security and ops teams are asking about a short-term, high-touch availability guarantee for the pilot window (Sept 1 - Oct 15) so we can validate latency under production traffic.

Key asks from our side:
- p95 latency below 120ms for synchronous generation calls (peak load estimates attached)
- guaranteed availability of 99.95% during business hours (M-F, 8am-6pm PT) for the pilot window
- cross-region failover configured for our primary region (us-west) to us-east with automated DNS failover
- 30-day extended logs retention (offset from your default) for troubleshooting during the pilot

I’ve attached our pilot requirements and a short term-sheet that the procurement team will use during contract talks. Let me know if any of this is a hard blocker. We'd like to lock operational commitments in the SOW so internal stakeholders sign off on the pilot.

Appreciate a quick read — we are hoping for a yes/no by end of week so our procurement queue stays unblocked.

Best,
Sana
Sana Ahmed
Head of AI Integrations, Solace Health

Team — forwarding Solace's asks. Topline: this is a strategic pilot (healthcare vertical, potential expansion across 40 clinics) and they want a short-term, stricter availability/latency commitment for the pilot period. Can product/ops confirm feasibility and the engineering/ops changes needed?

Questions I want answered before I reply to procurement:
1) Can we guarantee p95 < 120ms during business hours for a 6-week pilot with an ingress profile like their attachment? What capacity reservation does that map to (dedicated pool / priority tenancy)?
2) What impact to other customers if we reserve capacity or change routing? Are there safety/fallthrough policies we must tweak?
3) How long to stand up cross-region automatic failover (us-west -> us-east) with TTLs and test plan?
4) Can we bump logs retention to 30 days for their account quickly, and what storage/cost delta does that add?

Marcus — I assume pricing/discount will be needed for this. Please suggest structure. Monica — please prepare a short onboarding playbook note for a high-touch pilot (SRE rotations, postmortem cadence, escalation path).

I’ll aim to consolidate and reply to Solace by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: availability support for Sep pilot

Rishi — quick technical readout from product/infra:

Short answer: feasible with constraints. We can hit p95 ~110-125ms depending on prompt shapes and model selection. To make this reliable we need either:
- Reserved dedicated capacity for the pilot (preferred) OR
- A prioritized routing tier with guaranteed burst isolation (more complex to implement safely).

Operational changes required:
- Provision a small dedicated GPU pool (2x A100-equivalent) pinned to Solace for business hours with autoscale rules for burst.
- Configure cross-region standby in us-east with active-passive KV cache warmup; this requires a one-week provisioning and a runbook test (DNS failover drill).
- Increase retention for logs and traces to 30 days (adds ~1.6TB/month for expected traffic). Storage cost estimate: ~$1,200/month (hot storage), or use cold tier for cheaper but slower retrieval.
- Instrument a warmup phase for the first 72 hours of the pilot to prepopulate caches and reduce cold-start variance.

Trade-offs / risks:
- Reserving capacity will increase unit cost and may require temporary throttling or preemption rules for some smaller customers if the pool is used inefficiently.
- Cross-region KV warmup can be brittle for models with large KV caches; we need to pick a model variant with compact KV state.

Action items and owners: 
- Infra (Grace) to scope capacity and test plan — ETA 3 business days.
- SRE (Monica) to draft high-touch rotation and escalation plan — ETA 2 business days.
- Sales (Marcus/Rishi) to finalize commercial ask and discount band — collaborate with finance.

Linking an internal note with suggested runbook: https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/solace/high-touch-playbook

I’ll prepare an internal estimate and one-pager for the SOW.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Product Manager, Runtime & Reliability
Redwood Inference

- Per-token usage billed at standard hosted rate for anything above baseline throughput; include a 15% pilot discount
- Addendum: if Solace converts to a committed Dedicated contract within 90 days, apply a 50% credit of the pilot fee toward their first month of committed capacity.
